desc: Derive/verify the algebra: `N = d(3y²+3dy+d²)`, bound `d ≤ N^(1/3)`, quadratic formula for `y`.
Write the complete Python solution (icbrt + divisor loop + quadratic check + `-1` fallback), wrapped in `main()` with `sys.stdin` read.
Handle edge cases: `N = 1`, `N = d³` (y = 0 rejected via `t > 0`), cube-root rounding corrected by integer adjustment loops.
Verify performance: ~10⁶ cheap modulo tests, `isqrt` only on divisors — well within limits.
Self-check correctness on N=397 (→ 12 11), N=1 (→ -1), and the large sample.
